resources.string: On the new device, choose “Link to existing device” and scan the code it shows.
gim needs the camera to scan the code. The camera is used only while this screen is open.
Without the camera, gim cannot scan the code. Allow camera access, or paste the code below.
Camera access is turned off for gim. Turn it on in the app settings, or paste the code below.
No camera is available. Paste the code below instead.
The new device shows a code too. Confirm only if both codes are the same; the new device then gets access to all your chats.
The new device is linked. It joins your chats on its next sync.
The new device was not linked.
